verdict.rationale: The only background automation in the evidence is Meilisync, which keeps databases synced with Meilisearch automatically, plus the engine generating embeddings for indexed documents on its own once an embedder is configured. Both are fixed, built-in behaviours rather than user-defined automations. The MCP integration is interactive and prompt-driven, not autonomous. Missing for 10: user-configurable scheduled or triggered automations, webhooks or event-driven workflows, autonomous agent runs, and any hands-on corroboration of background automation.
